use_cases.name: Evaluate loan eligibility through the single service method
use_cases.goal: Return one authoritative eligibility decision, ceiling amount and list of reasons for a person, identical for every caller.

stakeholders.interest: Learns before applying whether a loan is possible, how much, and exactly why not.
Payroll deduction node relies on the same answer the employee saw.
Loan book exposure stays within the policy ceilings.
Can show that one rule set, not three diverging copies, decided every case.

use_cases.trigger: Any caller asks an eligibility question: the loans screen, the guarantor lock, the payroll deduction node or the agent tool.
preconditions: The person has an active assignment and a salary structure holding monthly basic.
Loan policy configuration holds multiple_base, multiple_long and the service_years threshold.
Loan and guarantor ledgers are current up to the last posted payroll recovery.
postconditions_success: Caller receives eligible flag, ceiling_amount and a complete reasons list.
No loan, guarantor or salary record is modified by the evaluation.
postconditions_failure: Caller receives an explicit error with a reason; no partial decision is returned.
A decision with an empty reasons list is never shown to an applicant; a support ticket is raised instead.

main_flow.action: Receives the eligibility request for a person through GET /loans/eligibility/{personId}, the only eligibility method any caller may use.
Checks the loan ledger for any outstanding loan or salary advance held by the person and records a reason if one exists.
Checks the guarantor ledger for any guarantee by the person with no release date and records the guaranteed loan as a reason.
Computes the ceiling as configured multiple of monthly basic: 4x by default, 6x once service passes the five-year threshold.
Returns eligible, ceiling_amount and the reasons list; the loans screen shows each reason to the applicant word for word.

alternate_flows.condition: Person holds an outstanding loan or salary advance.
steps: Platform marks the person ineligible for both a new loan and a salary advance.
Platform continues to steps 3 and 4 so the caller receives every applicable reason, not only the first.

alternate_flows.condition: Person stands guarantor on an unreleased loan.
steps: Platform marks the person ineligible for an own loan and for standing guarantor again.
Reason names the guaranteed loan number.

alternate_flows.condition: Service exceeds the configured service_years threshold.
steps: Platform applies multiple_long (6x) instead of multiple_base (4x).
Reasons list carries an informational line stating the multiple applied.

exception_flows.condition: Person has no active assignment or the person ID is unknown.
exception_flows.handling: Platform returns ineligible with a reason stating no active assignment; no ceiling is computed.

exception_flows.condition: Salary structure has no monthly basic for the evaluation date.
exception_flows.handling: Platform returns ineligible with reason salary structure unavailable and alerts the payroll manager queue.

exception_flows.condition: Decision is ineligible but the reasons list is empty.
exception_flows.handling: Response is withheld from the applicant, a support ticket is raised with the request trace, and the applicant sees a holding message.

nfrs: Eligibility response within 300 ms at p95 per tenant under 50 concurrent callers.
Identical inputs return byte-identical decision, ceiling and reasons for all four callers, verified by a shared contract test.
Multiples and service threshold are read from configuration; changing them requires no code release.

user_stories.want: to check my loan eligibility and ceiling before I fill in an application
user_stories.so_that: I only apply for an amount the policy allows

acceptance.given: an employee with monthly basic of 40,000, four years of service and no loans or guarantees
acceptance.when: the employee opens eligibility on the loans screen
acceptance.then: the result shows eligible with a ceiling of 160,000

acceptance.given: the same employee profile with six years of service
acceptance.then: the result shows eligible with a ceiling of 240,000 and states that the 6x multiple was applied

user_stories.want: to see every reason I am ineligible in plain words
user_stories.so_that: I know what has to change before I can borrow

acceptance.given: employee E1041 stands guarantor on loan LN-2026-0041, which has no release date
acceptance.then: the result is ineligible and the reason names LN-2026-0041 as an unreleased guarantee

acceptance.given: an employee with an outstanding loan balance
acceptance.when: the employee checks eligibility for a salary advance
acceptance.then: the advance is refused with the same outstanding-loan reason shown for a new loan

user_stories.so_that: no caller can reach a different answer for the same person

use_cases.name: Apply for a loan and secure guarantor acceptance
use_cases.goal: Capture a loan application with its proposed guarantors, confirm eligibility for all of them and lock the guarantors once they accept.

stakeholders.interest: Gets a fast, reasoned answer and a clear guarantor status.
Understands that accepting blocks their own borrowing until release.
Only applications with two valid, locked guarantors reach sanction.

use_cases.trigger: An employee submits a loan application on the loans screen.
preconditions: The applicant is signed in with self scope.
The loan policy defines mandatory_count (2) and third_threshold.
Proposed guarantors are active employees of the same tenant.
postconditions_success: Loan application exists in state GUARANTORS_PENDING, moving to SANCTION_PENDING once two mandatory acceptances are recorded.
Each accepting guarantor carries currently_blocked = true.
postconditions_failure: Application is in state REJECTED with every reason stored and shown verbatim.
No guarantor is locked for a rejected application.

main_flow.action: Submits purpose, principal, tenure in months and the proposed guarantors on the loans screen.
Runs the single eligibility method for the applicant and for each proposed guarantor and rejects with reasons if any check fails.
Each mandatory guarantor reviews the request in the approvals inbox and explicitly accepts the guarantee.
Locks every accepting guarantor so they are ineligible to borrow or guarantee again until a release row is written.

alternate_flows.condition: Applicant fails eligibility but asks for director special terms.
steps: Platform records the override request with the failing reasons attached.
Application proceeds to guarantor acceptance flagged for director review in sanction.

alternate_flows.condition: Principal exceeds the configured third-guarantor threshold.
steps: Platform invites the third proposed guarantor after eligibility is confirmed for that person.
Third acceptance is recorded with mandatory = false.

exception_flows.condition: Application names fewer guarantors than mandatory_count.
exception_flows.handling: Submission is refused at the form with a message stating two guarantors are required.

exception_flows.condition: Applicant or any proposed guarantor is ineligible.
exception_flows.handling: Application moves to REJECTED, loan.application.rejected is emitted and each reason is shown; demo case E1041 is rejected because he guarantees LN-2026-0041.

exception_flows.condition: A guarantor declines or does not respond.
exception_flows.handling: Application stays in GUARANTORS_PENDING; the applicant may substitute a guarantor, which re-runs eligibility for the substitute only.

exception_flows.condition: Guarantor accepted another guarantee between proposal and acceptance.
exception_flows.handling: Second acceptance is refused because the guarantor is already locked; applicant is asked to substitute.

nfrs: Eligibility result for applicant plus three guarantors shown within 2 s at p95 of submission.
Guarantor lock and acceptance commit atomically; no window exists in which a guarantor has accepted but is not locked.

user_stories.want: to apply for a loan naming my guarantors in one form
user_stories.so_that: I do not have to chase paperwork separately

acceptance.given: an eligible employee requests 150,000 over 24 months naming two eligible colleagues
acceptance.then: the application is created in GUARANTORS_PENDING and both colleagues receive an acceptance request

acceptance.given: the same form with only one guarantor named
acceptance.then: submission is refused with the message that two guarantors are mandatory

user_stories.want: to accept a guarantee explicitly and see what it blocks for me
user_stories.so_that: I make an informed commitment

acceptance.given: a colleague has named me as mandatory guarantor
acceptance.when: I accept the request in my approvals inbox
acceptance.then: my acceptance is timestamped and my status shows blocked from borrowing or guaranteeing until release

acceptance.given: I am already locked as guarantor on another active loan
acceptance.then: the application fails eligibility with a reason naming my existing guarantee

user_stories.want: to know immediately when my application is rejected and why
user_stories.so_that: I can resolve the blocker or choose different guarantors

acceptance.given: application LN-APP-2026-0014 is submitted by E1041, who guarantees LN-2026-0041
acceptance.then: the application is REJECTED and the reason names the unreleased guarantee

acceptance.given: one proposed guarantor is ineligible but the applicant is eligible
acceptance.then: the reason identifies which guarantor failed and why, without exposing that guarantor's salary

use_cases.name: Sanction a loan, including director special-terms override
use_cases.goal: Route an accepted application through the amount-based sanction chain and create an active loan with its schedule and payroll deduction.

stakeholders.interest: Can grant special terms with an evidential record rather than a silent edit.
Sanctioned loans arrive with schedule and recovery already wired into payroll.
Every override names the approver, the reason and the rules waived.
Receives a sanction decision and a clear instalment plan.

use_cases.trigger: Loan application reaches SANCTION_PENDING after mandatory guarantor acceptance.
preconditions: Approval chain for loan sanction is configured by amount band.
override_role is configured as Director.
At least two mandatory guarantors have accepted and are locked.
postconditions_success: Loan is ACTIVE with principal, instalment, tenure and first_recovery_run recorded.
A payroll deduction input exists for the first recovery run.
Any override is stored as an approval with approver, reason and the rules_waived list.
postconditions_failure: Loan is REJECTED with approver comment; guarantors receive explicit release rows.

main_flow.action: Receives the application routed by principal band to the configured sanction chain and records a decision on the approvals inbox.
Where policy is exceeded, sanctions on special terms on the loans screen, stating the reason and each rule being waived.
Creates the loan, generates the instalment schedule and registers the deduction input for the first recovery run.

alternate_flows.condition: Application is within eligibility and ceiling.
steps: No special terms are needed; the chain approval alone sanctions the loan.

alternate_flows.condition: Principal falls in a higher amount band.
steps: Platform appends the additional approver levels defined for that band.
Each level decides in sequence before sanction.

exception_flows.condition: An approver in the chain rejects.
exception_flows.handling: Loan moves to REJECTED, applicant sees the comment, and explicit release rows are written for every locked guarantor.

exception_flows.condition: A user without the configured override role attempts special terms.
exception_flows.handling: Action is refused and logged; the request stays in SANCTION_PENDING.

exception_flows.condition: Override is attempted without a reason or without naming the rules waived.
exception_flows.handling: Save is blocked until reason and the rules_waived list are completed.

exception_flows.condition: Schedule or deduction input cannot be created.
exception_flows.handling: Sanction is rolled back as one unit; loan remains SANCTION_PENDING and finance is alerted.

nfrs: loan.sanctioned is delivered exactly once per loan_id to the payroll deduction node.
Override records are immutable once saved and retained for the long retention class.

user_stories.want: to sanction a loan above the ceiling on special terms with the waived rules recorded
user_stories.so_that: the exception is defensible at audit

acceptance.given: loan LN-2026-0012 for E1022 requests more than the computed ceiling
acceptance.when: the director sanctions on special terms citing the ceiling rule as waived and gives a reason
acceptance.then: the loan becomes ACTIVE and the override record shows approver, reason and the ceiling rule in rules_waived

acceptance.given: an HR operations user without the override role
acceptance.when: the user attempts the same special-terms sanction
acceptance.then: the action is refused and an audit entry records the attempt

user_stories.want: applications routed automatically by amount band
user_stories.so_that: higher-value loans receive the extra scrutiny policy demands

acceptance.then: it routes to both approvers before sanction

acceptance.given: an application for 120,000
acceptance.then: it routes to the single first-band approver only

user_stories.so_that: no recovery is missed because someone forgot a manual input

acceptance.then: a deduction input of 10,000 exists for the March run and the schedule lists 12 instalments

acceptance.given: the deduction input cannot be written
acceptance.then: the loan remains SANCTION_PENDING and no partial loan record exists

use_cases.name: Recover loan instalments, close the loan and release guarantors
use_cases.goal: Post every payroll recovery against the loan, close it at zero outstanding and write explicit guarantor release rows.

stakeholders.interest: Regains eligibility the moment the guaranteed loan closes.
Sees an accurate outstanding balance after every payroll.
Loan book reconciles to payroll recoveries.
Release is evidenced by a dated row, not inferred.

use_cases.trigger: A payroll run that includes a loan recovery is finalised.
preconditions: Loan is ACTIVE with a deduction input in the run.
Payroll run has passed finalisation.
postconditions_success: Repayment row exists for the run and outstanding is reduced.
At zero outstanding the loan is CLOSED and every guarantor has released_on set and currently_blocked = false.
postconditions_failure: No repayment is posted for an unfinalised or reversed run.
Loan stays ACTIVE and guarantors remain locked until a valid closure.

main_flow.action: Posts the recovery from the finalised run as a repayment row and reduces outstanding by the recovered amount.
Checks whether outstanding is now zero and, if so, closes the loan and emits loan.closed.
Writes a dated release row for every guarantor of the closed loan and emits loan.guarantor.released for each.

steps: Loan stays ACTIVE; the next instalment remains scheduled for the following run.
Use case ends for this run.
Remaining balance is recovered in the full and final settlement or written off with approval.
Loan moves to FORECLOSED and guarantor release rows are written as on closure.

exception_flows.condition: Recovery would take net pay below the configured net-pay floor for the run.
exception_flows.handling: Recovery is reduced to protect the floor, the shortfall is rescheduled and the payroll manager is notified.

exception_flows.condition: Finalised run is later reversed.
exception_flows.handling: Linked repayment row is reversed with the run_id reference and outstanding is restored.

exception_flows.condition: Release row write fails.
exception_flows.handling: Closure is retried idempotently on loan_id plus guarantor until every release row exists; the loan is not reported CLOSED until then.

nfrs: Repayment posting completes within 5 minutes of run finalisation for 10,000 active loans.
Release events are idempotent on loan_id plus guarantor and retained for the long retention class.

acceptance.then: the loan is CLOSED and E1050 has a release row dated that day

acceptance.given: E1050 has been released
acceptance.then: no guarantee reason is returned

user_stories.so_that: my loans screen always matches my payslip

acceptance.given: an ACTIVE loan with 60,000 outstanding and a 10,000 instalment

acceptance.given: the March run is reversed after posting
acceptance.then: the repayment is reversed and outstanding returns to 60,000

user_stories.so_that: I can prove when each block was lifted

acceptance.given: a loan closed on 31 May with two guarantors
acceptance.when: I open the action history for the loan
acceptance.then: two release rows dated 31 May are listed with loan.guarantor.released references

acceptance.given: a loan with outstanding above zero
acceptance.then: no release rows exist and both remain blocked

use_cases.name: Request a salary advance or earned wage access
use_cases.goal: Let an eligible employee draw up to half of net pay already accrued in the open period, recovered automatically in the same payroll.

stakeholders.interest: Access to earned money between paydays without informal borrowing.
Every drawn amount is recovered through the run, with no manual adjustment.
Exposure never exceeds 50% of accrued net per person.

use_cases.trigger: Employee requests an advance against the current pay period.
preconditions: The payroll period is open and not locked.
Attendance for elapsed days of the period is processed.
The employee has no outstanding loan or advance.
postconditions_success: Advance is recorded in the loan ledger with a single recovery input in the current run.
Available amount for the period is reduced by the drawn amount.
postconditions_failure: No advance is recorded and the reason is shown to the employee.

main_flow.action: Opens loans and advances and requests an earned-wage advance for the current pay period.
Calls the single eligibility method and stops if any loan or advance is outstanding.
Computes accrued net pay to date from processed attendance, posted inputs and statutory deductions for elapsed days.
Shows the available amount as 50% of accrued net minus amounts already drawn this period, with the calculation lines.
Enters an amount within the available limit and confirms the request.
Records the advance in the loan ledger and raises a recovery input in the current named payroll run.
Releases the disbursement batch; disbursement always needs a named human release.
On run finalisation posts the recovery, clears the advance and restores eligibility.

alternate_flows.condition: Employee enters more than the available amount.
steps: Platform caps the entry at the available amount and explains the cap.

exception_flows.condition: Employee has an outstanding loan or advance.
exception_flows.handling: Request is refused with the same reason a new loan would receive.

exception_flows.condition: Payroll period is locked for processing.
exception_flows.handling: Request is refused with the date the next period opens.

exception_flows.condition: Accrued net to date is zero, for example all elapsed days are loss of pay.
exception_flows.handling: Available amount is shown as zero and the request cannot proceed.

nfrs: Available amount shown within 2 s at p95.
Accrued-net computation reuses the payroll engine so the advance limit matches the payslip basis.

user_stories.so_that: I can cover an urgent expense before payday

acceptance.given: the same employee has already drawn 4,000 this period

acceptance.given: an advance of 6,000 drawn on 12 June
acceptance.then: the payslip shows a 6,000 advance recovery linked to the advance

acceptance.given: the June run is finalised
acceptance.then: the advance is cleared and the employee is eligible again

use_cases.name: Run the annual compensation revision cycle
use_cases.goal: Cascade a revision budget, collect manager proposals, simulate cost, approve, issue revision letters and hand revised pay to payroll.

stakeholders.interest: Total revision cost stays within the approved budget.
Can differentiate increases for their team within a fair guideline.
Receives an accurate, timely revision letter.
Receives effective-dated revisions and arrears as payroll inputs.

use_cases.trigger: HR opens the annual revision cycle.
preconditions: Salary structures and grade ranges are current.
Revision letter templates are published with versions.
Approval chain for compensation revision is configured.
postconditions_success: Revised salary structures are effective-dated for every approved proposal.
Revision letters are issued with their template version retained.
Payroll inputs exist for revisions and any arrears.
postconditions_failure: Unapproved proposals leave salary structures unchanged.
Cycle remains open with a list of blocking items.

main_flow.action: Opens the cycle with effective date, eligibility cut-off and budget pool per legal entity.
Approves the total budget and cascades it by org unit as a percentage of eligible fixed pay.
Proposes an increase for each eligible direct report on the manager worksheet within the allocated budget.
Simulates revised CTC, employer statutory cost and budget utilisation, and flags proposals over budget or outside grade range.
Approves proposals through the configured chain, with over-budget items listed separately.
Locks the cycle; the platform writes effective-dated revised salary structures.
Drafts revision letters from versioned templates for human review before issue.
Issues the reviewed letters; each issue record keeps the template version that produced it.
Receives revisions and computed arrears as inputs to the named payroll run.

alternate_flows.condition: A proposal exceeds the manager's budget allocation.
steps: Manager either reduces it or submits it as a budget exception with a reason.
Exception routes to an additional approver level.

exception_flows.condition: Effective date falls in a payroll period already finalised.
exception_flows.handling: Platform computes arrears for the closed periods and raises them as a separate input.

exception_flows.condition: A letter template references a merge field that does not exist.
exception_flows.handling: Template fails validation on save; no draft is produced from it.

exception_flows.condition: Approver rejects a proposal.
exception_flows.handling: Proposal returns to the manager with the comment; salary structure is unchanged.

nfrs: Worksheet simulation refreshes within 1 s for a team of 50.
Cycle supports 10,000 eligible employees per tenant without manual batching.

user_stories.want: to allocate increases across my team on one worksheet with budget remaining shown live
user_stories.so_that: I stay within budget while rewarding my strongest people

acceptance.then: the reprint reproduces version 2 exactly

use_cases.name: Maintain salary structures and grade pay ranges
use_cases.goal: Hold minimum, midpoint and maximum pay per grade and location, and compute compa-ratio and range penetration for every assignment.

stakeholders.interest: Can spot under- and over-paid employees against their range.
Sees where team members sit in range when proposing pay.
Pay ranges reflect approved market positioning.

use_cases.trigger: A new pay range table is prepared for a grade and location, or a range is revised.
preconditions: Grades and locations exist in the organisation master.
Payroll manager has entity scope with salary-structure rights.
postconditions_success: An effective-dated range exists per grade and location.
Every assignment carries current compa-ratio and range penetration.
postconditions_failure: Invalid ranges are not published; existing ranges remain in force.

main_flow.action: Opens grade ranges and selects grade and location for the new effective date.
Enters annual minimum, midpoint and maximum fixed pay for each grade-location pair.
Validates minimum below midpoint below maximum and that the effective date does not overlap a published range.
Previews employees falling below minimum or above maximum under the proposed range.
Publishes the range; prior range is end-dated the day before.
Recomputes compa-ratio as fixed pay divided by midpoint and penetration as position between minimum and maximum.
Reviews the out-of-range list and opens remediation items where needed.

alternate_flows.condition: Payroll manager imports ranges for many grades from a file.
steps: Platform validates each row and lists rejects with reasons.
Valid rows are staged for preview.

exception_flows.condition: Minimum exceeds midpoint or midpoint exceeds maximum.
exception_flows.handling: Row is rejected with the failing comparison named.

exception_flows.condition: Effective date overlaps an existing published range.
exception_flows.handling: Publication is blocked until the earlier range is end-dated.

nfrs: Compa-ratio recomputation completes within 10 minutes for 25,000 assignments.
Range history is retained for seven years.

user_stories.want: to publish pay ranges per grade and location with effective dates
user_stories.so_that: pay decisions reference a controlled range

use_cases.name: Run merit, bonus and variable pay cycles
use_cases.goal: Distribute a budgeted merit or bonus pool using eligibility rules and a performance-by-compa-ratio guideline matrix, then hand approved amounts to payroll.

stakeholders.interest: Gets clear guidance on what each rating and position in range justifies.
Pool spend stays within the approved budget.
Rewards are consistent with performance and paid on time.

use_cases.trigger: HR opens a merit or bonus cycle after performance ratings are final.
preconditions: Final performance ratings exist for the cycle.
Pay ranges and compa-ratios are current.
Pool budget is approved by finance.
postconditions_success: Approved awards exist per employee and are raised as payroll inputs in the named run.
postconditions_failure: Unapproved awards create no payroll input.

main_flow.action: Defines the cycle: type (merit or bonus), eligibility rules, pool size and payout run.
Loads the guideline matrix of increase or payout percentage ranges by rating and compa-ratio band.
Applies eligibility rules such as minimum service and excludes employees on notice.
Pre-fills each manager worksheet with the guideline midpoint for every eligible employee.
Adjusts recommendations within guideline and enters a justification for any out-of-guideline amount.
Approves worksheets through the configured chain with out-of-guideline items highlighted.
Confirms total spend against the pool.
Raises approved awards as payroll inputs in the named run and updates salary structures for merit increases.

alternate_flows.condition: Manager's total exceeds the allocated pool share.
steps: Platform shows the excess and blocks submission until it is resolved or flagged as a budget exception.

exception_flows.condition: An employee lacks a final rating.
exception_flows.handling: Employee is listed as pending rating and excluded until the rating is final.

exception_flows.condition: Named payroll run is already finalised.
exception_flows.handling: Inputs move to the next open run with a notice to the payroll manager.

nfrs: Worksheet guideline recalculates within 1 s per change.
Every out-of-guideline award retains its justification for audit.

use_cases.name: Administer equity and ESOP grants
use_cases.goal: Track grants, vesting, exercises and the perquisite value that payroll must tax on exercise.

stakeholders.interest: Sees vested and unvested options and tax impact before exercising.
Receives exercise perquisite values for withholding.
Equity records reconcile to the grant register.

use_cases.trigger: A grant is approved or an employee exercises vested options.
preconditions: ESOP scheme with vesting rules is configured.
Fair market value per valuation date is recorded by finance.
postconditions_success: Grant, vesting tranches and exercises are recorded per employee.
Perquisite value is raised as a payroll input in the exercise month.
postconditions_failure: Exercise is not recorded and no payroll input is raised.

main_flow.action: Records a grant with scheme, number of options, exercise price and grant date.
Generates vesting tranches from the scheme schedule, for example 25% per year over four years.
Views vested, unvested and exercised options on the self-service equity page.
Submits an exercise request for vested options.
Computes perquisite value as fair market value on exercise date minus exercise price, multiplied by options exercised (to be validated by Legal).
Confirms the exercise and the fair market value used.
Raises the perquisite value as a taxable payroll input in the exercise month.

steps: Unvested tranches lapse per scheme rules on the last working day.
Vested options remain exercisable for the scheme's post-exit window.

exception_flows.condition: Requested options exceed vested balance.
exception_flows.handling: Request is refused with the vested balance shown.

exception_flows.condition: No fair market value is recorded for the exercise date.
exception_flows.handling: Exercise is held until finance records a value.

nfrs: Vesting schedule generation is deterministic for the same scheme and grant date.

user_stories.want: to see my vested and unvested options at any time
user_stories.so_that: I can plan an exercise

acceptance.given: a grant of 1,000 options on 1 April 2025 vesting 25% yearly
acceptance.when: I view my equity on 2 April 2026
acceptance.then: 250 options show vested and 750 unvested

acceptance.given: I exercised 100 options
acceptance.then: 150 vested, 100 exercised and 750 unvested are shown

user_stories.want: the perquisite value of an exercise raised as a payroll input
user_stories.so_that: tax is withheld in the correct month

acceptance.given: 100 options exercised at price 50 with fair market value 210
acceptance.then: a perquisite input of 16,000 is raised in the exercise month

acceptance.given: no fair market value is recorded for the date
acceptance.then: it is held and finance receives a request for a value

use_cases.name: Enrol employees and dependants in group insurance
use_cases.goal: Manage medical, accident and life cover enrolment with dependants, top-ups, enrolment windows, life events and insurer data exchange.

stakeholders.interest: Family is covered from the right date with the chosen top-up.
Enrolment windows close on time with complete data.
Top-up premiums are deducted correctly.

use_cases.trigger: Enrolment window opens, a new joiner is hired, or a life event is reported.
preconditions: Policy plans, sum-insured options and top-up premiums are configured.
Enrolment window dates are set.
postconditions_success: Enrolment with covered dependants is confirmed and included in the next insurer file.
Top-up premium deduction is raised as a payroll input.
postconditions_failure: Enrolment remains in draft and the employee keeps default cover.

main_flow.action: Opens the enrolment window with start and end dates and notifies eligible employees.
Reviews default cover and adds dependants with relationship, date of birth and identity document.
Selects an optional top-up and sees the annual premium and monthly deduction.
Validates dependant eligibility rules such as age limits and relationship types.
Submits the enrolment and gives consent for sharing dependant data with the insurer.
Raises the top-up premium as a recurring payroll deduction.
Generates the insurer addition and deletion file for the period.
Reconciles the insurer's confirmation and resolves rejected members.

alternate_flows.condition: Employee reports a life event such as marriage or a birth outside the window.
steps: Platform opens a 30-day life-event window for that employee only.
Employee adds the new dependant with evidence.

exception_flows.condition: Dependant exceeds the configured age limit.
exception_flows.handling: Dependant is rejected with the limit shown.

exception_flows.condition: Window closes before submission.
exception_flows.handling: Default cover applies and the draft is retained for HR review.

exception_flows.condition: Insurer rejects a member record.
exception_flows.handling: Rejection appears on HR's queue with the insurer's reason for correction and resubmission.

nfrs: Dependant identity documents are stored encrypted and visible only to self and HR benefits roles.
Insurer file generation completes within 15 minutes for 20,000 members.

user_stories.want: to add my spouse and children to medical cover during the window
user_stories.so_that: my family is protected from the policy start

acceptance.given: the window is open from 1 to 15 March and I have no dependants enrolled
acceptance.when: I add a spouse and two children and submit on 10 March
acceptance.then: enrolment is confirmed and all three dependants appear in the next insurer file

acceptance.given: I add a parent aged 82 where the limit is 80
acceptance.then: the parent is rejected with the age limit shown

user_stories.want: to buy a top-up with the monthly cost shown before I confirm
user_stories.so_that: I know the impact on my net pay

acceptance.given: a top-up with annual premium 6,000
acceptance.then: the monthly deduction shows 500 and a payroll input is raised from the next run

acceptance.given: I remove the top-up during the window
acceptance.then: the deduction input is withdrawn

user_stories.want: a life-event window opened only for the affected employee
user_stories.so_that: mid-year additions are controlled

acceptance.given: employee E1018 reports a birth on 5 July
acceptance.then: E1018 has a window until 4 August and others do not

acceptance.given: the window lapses without submission
acceptance.then: the newborn is not added and HR is notified

use_cases.name: Manage NPS and superannuation contributions
use_cases.goal: Capture employee choices for NPS and superannuation and compute contributions within configured statutory caps for payroll.

stakeholders.interest: Contributions follow the elected rate and appear on the payslip.
Contributions are computed within caps without manual overrides.
Remittances reconcile to payroll.

use_cases.trigger: Employee elects or changes a retirement contribution, or a payroll run computes contributions.
preconditions: Retirement plans, allowed rates and statutory caps are configured per entity (to be validated by Legal).
Employee holds a valid retirement account identifier where the plan requires one.
postconditions_success: Election is stored effective from the next open period.
Employer and employee contributions appear in the run and the remittance file.

main_flow.action: Opens retirement benefits and views current elections for NPS and superannuation.
Selects a contribution rate from the plan's allowed options and provides the account identifier.
Validates the account identifier format and the rate against plan options.
Shows the projected monthly employer and employee contribution and tax treatment note.
Confirms the election, effective from the next open payroll period.
Computes contributions in each run and applies the configured cap, routing any excess per plan rules.
Reviews the contribution register and generates the remittance file.

alternate_flows.condition: Election change window is restricted to once per financial year.
steps: Platform shows the date of the last change and the next permitted change date.

exception_flows.condition: Account identifier is missing or invalid.
exception_flows.handling: Election cannot be confirmed until a valid identifier is entered.

exception_flows.condition: Employer contribution exceeds the configured cap.
exception_flows.handling: Excess is treated per plan configuration and flagged on the register.

nfrs: Cap rules are versioned with effective dates so past runs recompute identically.

user_stories.want: to choose my NPS contribution rate and see the monthly effect
user_stories.so_that: I plan my retirement savings

acceptance.given: allowed employer rates of 0%, 5% and 10% of basic and basic of 50,000
acceptance.then: the projection shows 5,000 per month from the next open period

acceptance.given: I have not entered an account identifier
acceptance.then: confirmation is blocked asking for the identifier

user_stories.want: configured caps applied automatically every run
user_stories.so_that: no contribution breaches the cap

acceptance.given: an employee whose employer contribution would exceed the configured cap by 1,200
acceptance.then: the excess of 1,200 is treated per plan configuration and flagged

acceptance.given: a cap change effective 1 April
acceptance.then: March uses the cap in force in March

use_cases.name: Allocate and reconcile a flexible benefits plan
use_cases.goal: Let employees allocate a flexi budget across a benefits catalogue, claim against it with proofs and reconcile at year end.

stakeholders.interest: Can structure pay tax-efficiently within policy.
Taxable and exempt amounts are correct at year end.

use_cases.trigger: Flexi declaration window opens, a claim is submitted, or year end is reached.
preconditions: Flexi budget is part of the salary structure.
Catalogue items with limits and proof rules are configured.
postconditions_success: Allocations, claims and year-end taxable residue are recorded and flow to payroll.
postconditions_failure: Unallocated budget is paid as taxable allowance.

main_flow.action: Opens the flexi plan and sees the annual budget and catalogue items with limits.
Allocates the budget across items such as meal, fuel, telephone and leave travel.
Validates each allocation against item limits and the total budget.
Submits claims with proofs during the year against allocated items.
Verifies proofs and approves or rejects each claim.
Pays approved claims as exempt reimbursements in the named run.
At year end treats allocated but unproven amounts as taxable and raises the input.

alternate_flows.condition: Employee makes no allocation by the window close.
steps: Full budget defaults to the taxable allowance.

exception_flows.condition: Allocation exceeds an item limit or the total budget.
exception_flows.handling: Allocation is rejected with the limit shown.

exception_flows.condition: Proof is illegible or does not match the item.
exception_flows.handling: Claim is rejected with reason and the amount stays available to claim.

nfrs: Year-end reconciliation for 20,000 employees completes within one hour.

user_stories.want: to split my flexi budget across items within their limits
user_stories.so_that: I use the plan to my advantage

acceptance.given: an annual flexi budget of 1,20,000 and a meal limit of 26,400
acceptance.when: I allocate 26,400 to meal and 93,600 across other items
acceptance.then: the allocation is accepted

acceptance.given: I allocate 30,000 to meal
acceptance.then: the meal line is rejected naming the 26,400 limit

user_stories.want: unproven allocations taxed at year end automatically
user_stories.so_that: annual tax computation is correct

acceptance.given: an employee allocated 24,000 to fuel and proved 18,000
acceptance.then: 6,000 is raised as a taxable input

acceptance.given: all allocations are fully proved
acceptance.then: no taxable residue input is raised

use_cases.name: View an annual total rewards statement
use_cases.goal: Give each employee a statement of fixed pay, variable pay, benefits, employer statutory contributions and perks for the year.

stakeholders.interest: Understands the full value of employment beyond take-home pay.
Can publish statements without manual compilation.

use_cases.trigger: HR publishes statements for a financial year, or an employee opens their statement.
preconditions: Payroll for the year is finalised.
Benefit and perk costs per employee are recorded.
postconditions_success: Statement is available to the employee only, with each figure traceable to its source.
postconditions_failure: Statement is not published if any source total fails reconciliation.

main_flow.action: Selects the financial year and the population and triggers statement generation.
Aggregates fixed pay, variable pay, employer PF, ESIC and gratuity provision, benefit premiums and perks per employee.
Reconciles each statement total to finalised payroll and benefit cost registers.
Reviews a sample and publishes statements.
Opens their statement on mobile or web and views each category with a breakdown.
Downloads the statement as a document.

steps: Statement covers the months of service only and states the period.

exception_flows.condition: Statement total does not reconcile to payroll.
exception_flows.handling: Employee is excluded from publication and listed for HR investigation.

nfrs: Statement opens within 3 s on a mid-range mobile device.
Only the employee and HR with entity scope can view a statement.

user_stories.want: to see the full value of my pay and benefits in one statement
user_stories.so_that: I understand my total reward

acceptance.given: fixed pay of 9,60,000, bonus of 80,000, employer PF of 21,600 and medical premium of 18,000
acceptance.then: each category shows the amount and the total shows 10,79,600

acceptance.given: I joined on 1 October
acceptance.then: it states the period October to March

user_stories.want: statements withheld when totals do not reconcile
user_stories.so_that: no employee receives a wrong statement

acceptance.given: an employee whose statement total differs from payroll by 2,000
acceptance.then: that employee is excluded and listed for investigation

acceptance.given: all totals reconcile
acceptance.then: every employee in scope receives a statement

use_cases.name: Analyse pay equity and track remediation
use_cases.goal: Measure pay gaps by gender and other permitted attributes controlling for grade, location and tenure, and track remediation to closure.

stakeholders.interest: Is paid fairly for comparable work.
Gets evidence for remediation budget decisions.
Can verify analysis method and remediation actions.

use_cases.trigger: HR runs a scheduled or ad-hoc pay equity analysis.
preconditions: Attributes used are permitted by tenant policy and consented where required under the DPDP Act 2023 (to be validated by Legal).
Grade, location and tenure data are complete.
postconditions_success: Adjusted and unadjusted gaps are published to authorised roles with method notes.
Remediation items are tracked with owner, amount and status.
postconditions_failure: Results for groups below the minimum size are suppressed.

main_flow.action: Selects the population, the attribute to analyse and the control variables grade, location and tenure.
Checks each comparison group meets the minimum group size and suppresses smaller groups.
Computes the unadjusted gap and the adjusted gap controlling for the chosen variables.
Lists individuals whose pay falls outside the expected band for their controls, visible only to authorised HR.
Creates remediation items with proposed adjustment, owner and target date.
Approves the remediation budget.
Routes approved adjustments into the compensation revision process and tracks closure.

steps: Platform runs it automatically and notifies HR when results are ready.

exception_flows.condition: A comparison group has fewer than the minimum members.
exception_flows.handling: Group result is suppressed and marked as insufficient size.

exception_flows.condition: Attribute is not permitted by tenant policy.
exception_flows.handling: Attribute is not selectable and the attempt is logged.

nfrs: Individual-level results are restricted to roles with explicit pay-equity grant.
Analysis method and inputs are retained so a run can be reproduced.

user_stories.want: to see the gender pay gap adjusted for grade, location and tenure
user_stories.so_that: I can distinguish structural gaps from unexplained ones

acceptance.given: a population of 1,200 employees with complete controls
acceptance.when: I run the analysis by gender
acceptance.then: both unadjusted and adjusted gaps are shown with the method note

acceptance.given: a grade-location group with 4 members and a minimum size of 10
acceptance.then: that group is suppressed as insufficient size

user_stories.want: remediation items with cost and status
user_stories.so_that: I can approve a budget and see it applied

acceptance.given: 12 remediation items totalling 9,60,000
acceptance.then: items move to approved and are routed into the next revision cycle

acceptance.given: an approved item is applied in the revision cycle
acceptance.then: the item shows closed with the effective date
